Akkadian Animated History on a Map:
History of the Akkadians Explained on a Map.
Why did History's 1st Empire Collapse?
This animated documentary covers the time period from before the founding of the empire by Sargon of Akkad to the height of empire...and eventual collapse.
Naramsin, Manishtushu, Rimush, and Shar Kali Shari's reigns are covered before the time of confusion and collapse.
Entire history of the Akkadians. Collapse of History's 1st Empire. Explained on a MAP with Drawings.
False God Kings of Akkad. Entire history of the Akkadian Empire's Rise and Fall. Explained on a MAP
